svg.aria-label: Left: the squares of a missing south wing with W and S on the sides of C, at v = 0, s = 0.2, d = 0.75, in the smallest disk that allows these separations (radius 1.739); the separating lines of the stress with the weights 4, 3, 3 in colour (the separations of S and D from C, not used, in grey) and the forces of the stress. Right: the domain of (v, d), shaded by the profile, with the lower bounds of Table D.7
